EDWARDS MARKET THOUGHTS
10/16/2026 8:00 am
Grains and oilseeds are trading lower heading into the weekend with harvest to ramp back up in the Midwest this weekend and early next week.
Weather maps showing a drier pattern the next 10 days for harvest in the Midwest.
USDA at 8 am export sales announcements are expected to reflect 8-10 soybean cargoes booked by China yesterday.
China is thought to have booked 20-23 bean cargoes this week for Dec-Mar slot.
Farmer selling of soybeans is steady given the good/record yields. Support for SX after $12.56-12.50 is toward the $12.25-12.00 area.
